title: Why You Keep Checking Your Phone (Even When There's Nothing New)

visual.description: Stickman stands on the left at x=0.25 holding a smartphone. Screen illuminates with bright phone glow. Desk edge and room horizon line visible. UI badge displays 'PHONE UNLOCK'.
Camera zooms in slightly. Stickman at x=0.25 looks down at phone. On right side (x=0.70), UI card pops in with clear text '0 MESSAGES' and empty inbox icon. Desk edge in background.
Stickman stays at x=0.25. On the right, a bell icon appears with a crimson slash and prominent keyword 'NO NOTIFS'. Desk edge remains visible.
Close-up. Stickman at x=0.25 stares blankly with deadpan eyes. A bold gray label 'NOTHING' hovers over the blank glowing phone screen. Window silhouette visible in background.
Stickman at x=0.25 clicks phone side button. Screen snaps black with card 'SCREEN LOCKED'. Desk edge and room horizon line visible.
Stickman stands at x=0.25 tapping foot. On the right, a stylized countdown clock prop animates rapidly with text '5 SECONDS'. Desk edge in background.
Stickman at x=0.25 snaps phone up; bright screen phone glow illuminates character. Badge displays 'RE-OPENED'. Desk edge in background.
Stickman stands at x=0.75 looking directly at camera with sarcastic smirk, clapping slowly. Confetti ribbon hangs frozen on left with label 'GREAT JOB'. Desk edge in background.
Camera shake punchline. Stickman at x=0.25 points dramatically to a giant floating red badge on right displaying '0 NEW UPDATES'. Desk edge and window silhouette.

scenes.narration_text: So why do we keep doing this?

visual.description: Stickman at x=0.25 scratches chin in thinking pose. On right side, a large stylized question mark floats with keyword 'WHY REPEAT?'. Floor horizon line in background.

scenes.narration_text: Your brain learns that checking your phone

visual.description: Stickman at x=0.25 points toward an elegant minimalist 2D brain vector diagram on the right (x=0.70). Brain diagram features neural pathway label 'DOPAMINE LOOP'. Desk edge visible.
Brain vector diagram lights up with a warm gold glow. Stickman at x=0.25 looks up as a glowing idea lightbulb and badge 'POTENTIAL REWARD' pop in on the right.
Stickman at x=0.25 gestures to a bright blue chat bubble popping up on the right with keyword 'NEW MESSAGE' and 3 preview dots. Desk edge in background.
Stickman at x=0.25 smiles broadly. Next card pops in on the right: a video player frame with a play button and label 'FUNNY VIDEO'. Horizon line visible.
Third card pops in with exclamation accent and headline label 'FRESH NEWS'. Stickman at x=0.25 raises eyebrows with curiosity. Desk edge visible.

scenes.narration_text: And because you never know when something will appear,

visual.description: Stickman shifts to x=0.25. On the right side, an animated rolling slot-machine tumbler spins between empty symbols and star icons, labeled 'UNPREDICTABLE TIMING'.
On the right, a circular loop arrow connects 'CUE -> ACTION -> REWARD' with keyword 'HABIT LOOP'. Stickman at x=0.25 nods in understanding. Desk edge in background.
Stickman at x=0.25 smiles. A green card slides in on the right with a gold star and clear bold keyword 'WIN REWARD'. Desk edge visible.
Beside the green card, a dark grey card drops in with a simple red cross and keyword 'ZERO REWARD'. Stickman drops his arms, sighing. Desk edge visible.
The green card pulses with gold light. A glowing percentage badge '1% CHANCE' hovers above it. Stickman at x=0.25 leans in with fascinated eyes.
A stylized red magnet prop on the right pulls dynamic magnetic force lines toward Stickman. Stickman at x=0.25 leans involuntarily to the right with surprised eyes.
Wide establishing shot. Stickman sits at a clean wooden desk silhouette at x=0.25 under a window silhouette with gentle sunlight. Horizon line grounds the room.

scenes.narration_text: you don't even need a notification.

visual.description: Camera moves to medium. On the right (x=0.75), a bell icon floats with a soft gray cross-out badge displaying 'ZERO PINGS'. Stickman at x=0.25 rests chin in hand.

scenes.narration_text: A quiet moment, a little boredom,

visual.description: Subtle thought cloud overhead with keyword 'A LITTLE BORED'. Stickman taps finger on desk edge at x=0.25. Phone rests innocently on the right side of desk.

scenes.narration_text: and suddenly your hand is reaching for your phone.

visual.description: Motion line speed streaks! Stickman's arm extends reflexively toward the phone on the desk. Phone screen emits a soft phone glow. Desk edge visible.
Stickman at x=0.25 points up to a cartoon speech bubble sprouting from head labeled 'INTERNAL DIALOGUE'. Desk edge and room horizon line visible.

scenes.narration_text: "Let's see if the internet has changed

visual.description: Stickman holds phone at x=0.25. On the right, a stylized 2D globe wireframe vector spins with keyword 'INTERNET FEED'. Room horizon line in background.
Close-up. Stickman's eyes widen with comedic shock. Giant digital stopwatch badge on right displays '12 SECONDS' with tiny question marks. Desk edge visible.
Stickman stands upright at x=0.25, raising a firm hand in a calm 'halt' gesture. Desk edge and wall shadow ground the character.

scenes.narration_text: to throw your phone into the ocean.

visual.description: Humorous visual on right side: a stylized wave icon with a phone splashing into water, stamped with a bold red circle-backslash 'NO OCEANS'. Stickman at x=0.25 shakes head.
Stickman at x=0.25 reaches toward a modern clean UI settings card that slides in from right. Card displays icon of a phone settings gear. Desk edge visible.
On the right (x=0.70), UI toggle switch animates from ON to OFF with a crisp green/gray flip and label 'NOTIFS OFF'. Stickman at x=0.25 smiles approvingly. Desk edge visible.

scenes.narration_text: and checking messages at specific times.

visual.description: Next to the card, a wall clock prop appears with prominent green scheduled time blocks and badge 'SET SCHEDULE'. Stickman at x=0.25 points to the schedule.
Stickman at x=0.25 presents a neat academic citation badge on the right displaying '2019 STUDY' and a clean research paper outline. Horizon line grounds the scene.
Floating notification pings gather smoothly and compress into a single organized container labeled 'BATCH SYSTEM'. Stickman at x=0.25 watches with satisfaction.
Three neat geometric boxes pop in horizontally across the right zone (x=0.55 to 0.90): 'BATCH 9 AM', 'BATCH 1 PM', 'BATCH 6 PM'. Stickman at x=0.25 gestures across all three.
Stickman at x=0.25 stands upright with upright posture. On the right, a target bullseye graphic appears with keyword 'DEEP FOCUS' and an upward trend arrow.
Beside the target, a badge displays 'IN CONTROL' with a solid teal checkmark. Stickman at x=0.25 crosses arms with confident smile. Horizon line grounds the room.
Camera pulls back smoothly to a wide shot. Stickman at x=0.25 stands calmly next to a clean minimalist desk silhouette under a soft window frame silhouette.
Camera frames stickman at x=0.25 looking toward a smartphone placed neatly face-down on the wooden desk edge at x=0.70. Subtle phone glow aura radiates around it.
Stickman at x=0.25 turns head to face the viewer. Floating minimalist card on right displays keyword 'QUIET PHONE' with soft glowing outlines.

scenes.narration_text: is a screen you haven't opened.

visual.description: Closing shot. Stickman at x=0.75 smiles warmly with arms relaxed. On the left (x=0.25), the face-down phone rests calmly on desk edge with clean badge 'SCREEN UNOPENED'. Room horizon line grounds scene.
